This page lists every calculation SCGSim supports, and links to the exact
reference for each. Palace and AEDT can do more than this; SCGSim supports only
what is listed here.

::: {.table-responsive}

| Calculation | Solver | Geometry input | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| Electrostatic | Palace | GeometryPlan snapshot; terminal and ground Nets | Capacitance matrix |
| Eigenmode | Palace | GeometryPlan snapshot; optional inductive ports | Mode frequency, Q, energies; optional EPR |
| Eigenmode | HFSS | GDS mapping, or GeometryPlan snapshot for EPR | Mode frequency, Q; optional EPR |
| Driven Modal | HFSS | GDS mapping; ports with integration lines | S-parameters, CSV and Touchstone |
| Driven Terminal | HFSS | GDS mapping; ports with reference conductors | S-parameters, CSV and Touchstone |
| 3D extraction | Q3D | 3D bodies (`Q3dSpec`), or GeometryPlan snapshot for C/G | C/G and optional AC R/L matrices |
| Cross-section extraction | Q2D | Rectangles and conductor groups | C/G/L/R per unit length |

:::

Every HFSS and Q3D request must set `modeling="solid"` or `"thin_film"`;
there is no default. See
[Solid and thin-film modeling](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#aedt-solid-thin-film).

**Not supported:** Palace Driven, Palace Magnetostatic, and curved geometry in
AEDT (AEDT runs use polygons).

## Energy participation and loss

Palace and HFSS Eigenmode can report surface, bulk and junction (port)
participation.

- Only what you request is reported. A channel you did not request is
  missing, not zero.
- Surface films need an explicit thickness, permittivity and loss tangent.
- HFSS evaluates top and bottom interfaces only; it does not compute film
  energy on metal sidewalls.
- The reported loss sum covers the evaluated channels only. It is not the
  device's total loss.

After a run you can:

- **compute EPR again from saved HFSS fields**, for example with other
  margins. This needs AEDT but no new solve. See
  [Compute EPR from saved AEDT fields](course/aedt-saved-fields.qmd).
- **change loss assumptions** on an existing EPR result without any solver.
  See [Change loss assumptions offline](course/offline-epr.qmd).

## Other features

- **Curved geometry (Palace).** Explicitly drawn curves, or curves fitted to
  selected GDS segments, keep their Entity identity and are meshed as curves.
  See [source curves](geometry-sgb.qmd#source-curves).
- **Mesh controls (Palace).** `geometry_order` sets how closely the mesh
  follows curved surfaces, independent of the finite-element order.
- **Model-only preparation (AEDT).** Q3D, HFSS and Q2D can build the model in
  AEDT, save it and close, without solving. See
  [model-only preparation](specs/aedt-runtime.qmd#aedt-model-only-preparation).

## Results are not interchangeable

One snapshot can feed several solvers, but each calculation has its own
boundaries and its own result. A lumped capacitance, a resonance frequency,
S-parameters and a per-unit-length matrix answer different questions. Keep
each result's units and its conductor, port or mode order.
